visual_review.method: All final pages viewed in three six-page contact sheets; detailed inspections of the primitive-rule and metrics pages also performed.
visual_review.findings: No clipped content, overlap, missing glyphs, or equation/table overflow observed. Title, contents, theorem blocks, code listing, references, and page numbers reviewed.

fonts: All 17 reported fonts are embedded Type 1 with Unicode mappings; see pdf_fonts.txt.
